en.name: Ubiquiti UniFi AP U6 Lite
en.shortDescription: Wi-Fi 6 ceiling-mount access point managed through the UniFi app.
en.description:
## Ubiquiti UniFi AP U6 Lite

A compact Wi-Fi 6 access point for ceiling or wall mounting, managed centrally through the UniFi mobile app or controller.

- Dual-band Wi-Fi 6, up to 1.5 Gbps combined
- Powered over Ethernet (802.3af)
- Supports up to 300 concurrent clients

so.description:
## Ubiquiti UniFi AP U6 Lite

Access point Wi-Fi 6 ah oo yar, loogu talagalay saabka ama derbiga, oo si dhexe loogu maamulo app-ka UniFi ama controller-ka.

- Wi-Fi 6 laba-baanto ah, ilaa 1.5 Gbps
- Waxaa lagu shaqaysiiyaa PoE (802.3af)
- Waxay taageertaa ilaa 300 isticmaale oo isku mar ah
